title: What Evidence Do AI Agent Audit Logs Need After Redaction? A matched-pair pilot on consent verification (code, fixtures, results and paper)
description:
Reproducible pilot (Python 3 standard library only, synthetic data). It measures whether a reviewer can verify consent for an AI agent's completed document share after the audit log is redacted. Twenty scripted runs (ten matched authorised/unauthorised pairs) are rendered as full logs, uniformly masked logs and logs with consistent within-run aliases, plus two ablations that omit expiry or revocation evidence. Run python3 run_pilot.py to reproduce every result.

Code: MIT. Paper, protocol, fixtures and results: CC BY 4.0. All records are fictional.
notes: Independent technical report and accompanying artefacts. Prepared with AI assistance; see the paper's acknowledgements.
